note.question: How do (and without) predictions affect the nonstationary newsvendor?
note.overview: The classic newsvendor model yields an optimal decision for a “newsvendor” selecting a quantity of inventory under the assumption that the demand is drawn from a known distribution. Motivated by applications such as cloud provisioning and staffing, we consider a setting in which newsvendor-type decisions must be made sequentially in the face of demand drawn from a stochastic process that is both unknown and nonstationary. All prior work on this problem either (a) assumes that the level of nonstationarity is known or (b) imposes additional statistical assumptions that enable accurate predictions of the unknown demand.
